title: [Master]-Incorrect Reservation Split Generated After Replanning a Replenishment Production Order Created by MRP Planning Run
summary: Fixed incorrect reservation splits when replanning production orders with multiple component lines using the same item. The fix rebuilds the reservation split instead of only adjusting the delta.
key_points: Resolves issue where replanning kept old reservation splits and only adjusted deltas
Adds event subscriber OnAfterShouldDeleteReservEntry in manufacturing layer
Handles cases with same component item on multiple production order lines
Includes test coverage for the fix
quote: replanning kept the old reservation split and only adjusted the delta, producing an incorrect reserved quantity per line
